flow_1.title: Doctor registers -> completes profile -> submits for approval
flow_1.status: WORKING (with flaw: profile_completed flag never updated in doctor profile)
flow_1.details: Registration creates Doctor record with is_approved=False, is_verified=False, appeal_status='pending'. Doctor dashboard warns complete profile until edit_profile is saved.

flow_2.title: Admin approves doctor -> appears in Find Doctors and department
flow_2.details: CRITICAL FLAW CONFIRMED: doctors_by_category route has hardcoded `Doctor.time_slots != {}` and `if not practices: continue`. An approved doctor without configured time slots is completely hidden from patient listings (HTTP 200 returns 0 doctors).

flow_3.title: Doctor writes a blog -> admin approves -> appears in public blog list
flow_3.details: Public blogs route queries status='published'. Draft vs pending submission works after Phase 3 TinyMCE and route fix (commit ac72000).

flow_4.title: Patient finds a doctor: department -> doctor list -> profile
flow_4.status: WORKING (for seeded doctors with slots; BROKEN for new doctors without slots)
flow_4.details: Find Doctors shows specialties. Category shows doctors with slots. Doctor card links directly to profile view /patient/doctor/<id>.

flow_5.title: Doctor manages time slots
flow_5.details: Doctor can configure practice locations, video and physical consultation fees, and weekly day/hour slots via /doctors/appointment-settings.

flow_6.title: Patient books: chooses doctor -> physical or online -> slot -> payment -> admin confirms -> doctor confirms
flow_6.details: Booking interface allows date and time selection, disease category, and payment upload. Admin payment verification works.

flow_7.title: Video consultation: doctor and patient join -> prescription -> patient views web and PDF
flow_7.details: Prescription view (/prescriptions/1) displays PMDC-compliant digital prescription with medicines, dosage, and PDF download link.

flow_8.title: Admin manages patients and doctors: view lists, view profile/details, activate/deactivate account
flow_8.details: Admin can view patient list and doctor list, but there is NO endpoint or UI to activate/deactivate (toggle is_active) patient or doctor accounts. Full activity summaries are incomplete.

flow_9.title: Staff roles: sub-admin restricted to assigned panels
flow_9.details: Staff Accountant is restricted to Accounts and Payments panels; attempts to access Patients panel redirect with access denied. File RBAC verified.
